# LFM3 VL 2B

Liquid AI · released 2026-10

Post-trained vision-language checkpoint. QAD Q4\_0 edition is additionally trained and not conflated with original BF16 measurements; GPU serving support still in progress per card. Verified Ollama image-input route requires Ollama \>=0.40.12 on macOS.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B/blob/ba44bd51db20a2753f28c273a1571ccaa210d954/README.md)
